systems.owner: Department of Transport (national, under section 6 of the principal Act)
systems.tiers: Provincial Regulatory Entities must keep prescribed particulars of operators, associations and routes up to date in it; Municipal Regulatory Entities must obtain and keep the same information up to date for their functions

note: A statute: it lays a record-keeping duty on municipalities assigned the operating-licence function and states nothing about whether any municipal office is connected or works in the system. No fact taken from a legal duty.
